## Every playlist can be renamed, described and given a cover
- **Streyn Mixes and Your Top Songs too:** tap the title, the cover or the pencil on a Daily Mix, a genre or artist mix or a "Your Top Songs" year and change the name, the description and the cover, like for your own playlists (choose a photo, make a cover, or remove it again)
- **Stays when the mix changes:** the songs of a mix still change every day, your name, description and cover stay. Removing the text or the picture brings back the made one
- **On every device:** the changes are kept in your account, so the phone, the desktop app and the web player show the same
- Own playlists, imported playlists and Liked songs could already be edited and still can

## Install
- **Update server:** Settings → Updates → Update now (or run the Proxmox script)
- **Android / Windows / Linux:** nothing to install, the apps pick it up from the server
